properties.description: A project with NO instruction file still gets one the primary harness reads; the created file is a pointer, not a second home for instructions (size-bounded); an existing instruction file is appended to, not replaced; a project that already owns a convention gets NOTHING invented; the eight slash commands ship and match the kit source exactly; and SKILLS ARE STILL NOT COPIED, so the exception stays an exception (tools/test_init.py, 6 cases). Plus the guards that make shipping commands safe: a command naming a skill that does not exist FAILS the lint, and the .claude/commands mirror is byte-checked against the kit (tools/skill_lint.py).
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED three ways: restoring the only-append behaviour, emptying TREES, and pointing a command at a non-existent skill each fail exactly the check that names them.
properties.name: The install reaches the agent without inventing a convention the project already owns
